'''Groot''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]]. He was stationed aboard the [[Decimator (Star Destroyer)|''Decimator'']] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].
